title: Natural Heart Health Supplement Trial
summary: We are running a 3-month trial of an experimental natural heart health supplement. Participants will take a daily dose of an experimental natural heart health supplement in powdered format, chocolate flavor. The trial will assess changes in heart biomarkers such as Total Cholesterol, HDL-C, LDL-C, Triglycerides, and High-Sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP).
criteria:
Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals with known soy allergies
* Individuals with liver disease
* Pregnant or breastfeeding individuals
